longDescription: is a collection of short stories written in the early 20th century, capturing the essence of Appalachian life and culture. The narratives explore the lives of mountain people in Kentucky, featuring themes of love, rivalry, and the complex moral fabric of rural communities.

authorInfo.bio: Fox, John, Jr. (1862–1919) is the author of Hell Fer Sartain and Other Stories. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
